question: 13|How many countries has the gdp per capita lower than the world in 2019?
query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_name) FROM global_development_indicators WHERE calculated_gdp_per_capita > '2019'
answer: Based on the 2019 data, it appears that 204 countries have a GDP per capita that is lower than the world average. This indicates that approximately 98% of the world's countries have lower GDP per capita compared to the global average in 2019.
